title: Adobe AEM QueryBuilder servlet is exposed
summary: The AEM QueryBuilder JSON servlet answers an unauthenticated visitor, so anyone who can reach the site can query the whole content repository, including user and group nodes. It is a common way to pull internal content out of an AEM site and it bypasses many dispatcher filters.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known and the query result is told apart from a soft 404.

reproduce: curl -sk 'https://host/bin/querybuilder.json' and check the response is JSON with a hits array. If it answers, the QueryBuilder servlet is open and the whole repository can be queried, for example /bin/querybuilder.json?path=/home/users&type=rep:User.
remediate: Deny /bin/querybuilder* at the dispatcher so it returns 404, including the obfuscated and double-slash variants. Follow Adobe's AEM dispatcher security checklist.
